plain_english_policy: Restricting the expansion of hog farms

effects.rationale: The policy restricts the growth of a specific industry. This is likely to weaken environmental protection in the long term.

evidence_quote: Support a three-year moratorium on both new hog farms and all expansions of farms to over 500 hogs.
review_reason: The policy directly restricts the growth of a specific industry. This is likely to weaken environmental protection in the long term.
